text:
QUOTE: "`app/actions/remote/channel.ts:1397` (`archiveChannel`) | When viewable, the local channel gets `delete_at = now` and stays in the DB. When not, the current user is removed from the channel locally instead." and "`app/actions/websocket/channel.ts:463` ... If the current user is in the channel, they are kicked out with `CHANNEL_ARCHIVED`."

VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says that when archived channels are not viewable, the user is removed from the channel and kicked out if it is the current channel. When viewable, the channel stays with `delete_at` set, which marks it deleted.
